extra.reason: Fixed. A followed chain now answers the question the option asks in bytes: the engine keeps the wire truth (RedirectHop.RequestRaw/ResponseRaw, Response.Raw on the final response; hop requests rendered once so the scope gate authorises exactly the bytes the transport writes, hops sent via SendAs under the same rules as the operator's own send), the web layer maps them onto repeaterHop.request/response riding the send's own response, and the Repeater pane offers First/Final response plus per-hop 'View response' in the chain table — the chain is additive,  stays the operator's own. Follow-up fix the new tests caught: redirectRequest advertised the hop's Host as the bare hostname, dropping a non-default port — contradicts Burp's decompiled Zxrb.Zv authority rendering (host only for https/443 and http/80, host:port otherwise, IPv6 bracketed; :authority rewritten per hop on h2) and RFC 9112 3.2; hostPortFor now mirrors it. Evidence: sender tests TestAFollowedHopKeepsTheBytesItSentAndReceived / TestAnUnfollowedHopCarriesNoBytes / TestTheRawEntryKeepsTheFirstResponseBytesOnFinal, web test TestRepeaterServesTheChainHopsBytesAlongsideTheSend + byteless-refused-hop assertions; go build/vet/gofmt clean, whole-tree go test 38 pkgs ok, e2e-go.sh 24/0, e2e-ui 157 unit + axe green — e2e-ui's 8 failing specs fail identically at HEAD (bisected in a separate worktree) and are filed separately.

Fixed: all 8 failing specs resolved and the fixes verified manually in a real browser (agent-browser) as requested. Root causes: (1) RepeaterPage rendered hooks after its empty-state return — 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render' killed every fresh-browser flow (5 specs); hooks moved unconditional, a4dd7d5. (2) renderTabTrigger's ContextMenu wrapper had no key — React unkeyed-children console error the suite asserts against (1 spec); keyed on tab id, a4dd7d5. (3) dock-persistence spec used a '.editor' class that exists nowhere (editor root is editor-shell) — spec fix 0a41a14. (4) proxyGet was describe-scoped but called from another describe — ReferenceError; moved to module scope, 0a41a14. (5) in-scope-only spec asserted an empty-state string the product never rendered ('this filter' vs 'these filters') — spec fix, 0a41a14. (6) decoder spec clicked Add inside a collapsed empty section; now expands first, 0a41a14. Product fix discovered by manual testing: a typed history query matching nothing claimed 'No traffic captured yet' while a seeded capture sat behind it — the typed query was not in activeFilterNames; now named, verified live in the browser ('No exchange matches these filters ... query host = ...'), a4dd7d5. Note: full playwright suite was interrupted at 218/1 (decoder spec) before the expand-first spec fix; unit suites green throughout (go 38 pkgs, UI 157).

Forward all shipped: engine ForwardAll (mirrors DropAll once-only gate + single signal, forwards held bytes unmodified — nil would wake the client to an empty message), POST /api/intercept/forward-all answering the honest count, toolbar button between Forward and Drop all with the queue-moved toast, no confirmation needed for the safe direction. Verified manually in agent-browser: 3 held -> one click -> queue empty, clients unblocked with own bytes, history rows present. Engine test TestEngine_ForwardAllForwardsEveryHeldMessageUnmodifiedAndCountsOnlyItsOwn, web tests, route manifest, UI unit 157/0 green. Commits: see forward-all commit on ui-react-comparison.
